locale.label: Language
locale.help: Applies to this device. The tray and window update automatically.
tray.hint: Click for quick controls. Direction switches apply to all devices.
status.close_hint: Close this window to keep {app_name} running in the system tray. Click the tray icon for quick controls.
status.receipt_hint: Success confirms the destination clipboard at the time of delivery. A later copy can replace it.
devices.help: Allow sending separately for each device. Match the fingerprint shown on that device.
devices.empty: No {app_name} devices discovered on Tailscale yet.
devices.history: History (limited by the global history setting)
history.storage_hint: Text and the history list stay in memory. Images use a temporary encrypted cache. Restart clears history; removing items deletes their cached images.
notice.permission: Outgoing sync is disabled until you allow this device
result.copied: Copied history content to the system clipboard
result.resent.one: History queued as a new event for {count} device
result.resent.other: History queued as a new event for {count} devices
notice.remote_verified: remote OS readback and durable receipt completed
ui.send_hint: Your copies go to devices you allow.
ui.receive_hint: Received content can replace this clipboard.
ui.automatic_hint: Send each new copy to allowed devices when sending is enabled.
ui.manual_hint: Send the current clipboard to allowed devices.
ui.devices_hint: New devices cannot receive your copies until you allow sending. Receiving is enabled by default.
ui.allow_hint: Check the fingerprint on {name} before allowing outgoing copies.
ui.fingerprint_checked: I checked the fingerprint on the other device
ui.session_history: This session only · one item per event, with results for each device
ui.history_empty_hint: New local copies and received content appear here when history is enabled. Restarting clears session history.
ui.expired: This item expired or was cleared.
ui.content_unavailable: Content was not retained. Transfer results are still available.
ui.copy_hint: Copy follows automatic sync settings. Copy locally never sends. Resend starts a new transfer to currently allowed devices.
ui.clear_hint: Removes this session’s history and encrypted image cache. The system clipboard is unchanged.
ui.notification_hint: Show the device, content type and result, without clipboard contents.
ui.storage_limits: Storage limits: {text} MiB text · {images} MiB images
ui.limit_hint: The limit counts clipboard events, including local copies. Automatic delivery results share one event.
status.permissions_hint: Counts include offline devices. A direction is allowed only when both its global switch and device switch are on. These are local permissions; delivery also depends on the other device.
devices.history_pull: Receives through history while the app is open
result.history_pull: No live clipboard transfer queued; permitted devices retrieve retained history
notice.superseded: Clipboard transfer replaced by a newer copy
